title: Premier League Matchweek 3 kicks off Saturday with Liverpool-Fulham and Manchester derby on Sunday
summary: The Premier League returns on Saturday with Matchweek 3 headlined by Liverpool v Fulham at Anfield and Aston Villa v Nottingham Forest, before Sunday's Manchester derby at Old Trafford and Manchester United v Manchester City at the same ground. The midweek follows with Coventry City v Brighton on Sunday and Leeds United v Newcastle on Monday, with all 380 fixtures of the 2026/27 season already published by the Premier League.
